notes.title: Dawn of the Monsters Downloadable Content
notes.content:
Patch 1.2 for Dawn of the Monsters has arrived, bringing the long-awaited Arcade Edition DLC pack, as well as a ton of new free content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41455629/57888cb65fb11e0a3d4042157e4f6c5308ebc19b.png

Arcade Edition DLC pack

 Play as the new character Meteor Temujin in any mode
 Experience the Arcade Mode and aim for the highest leaderboards
 Unlock new Gallery and Archive files, and glimpse the future of DotM


Free update

 Challenge yourself with 10 unique Trials
 Play the story with a higher difficulty in the New Game+ mode
 Play with Japanese text and/or voice-acting


Learn more about the new content on the 13am Games website below.
https://www.13amgames.com/dotm-dlc1

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Added New Story +
 Added New Game +, ++, +++ and ++++
 Added Trials
 Added additional challenges
 Added Japanese VO and Localization


Added support for the Arcade Edition DLC, which includes:

 A new Arcade game mode
 A new playable character, Meteor Temujin
 Additional character skins

notes.title: Dawn of the Monsters Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Added internal challenge system! View your currently unlocked challenges in the Main Menu!
 Added a Restart Mission button! No more backing out all the way to the Command Center just to start a level over!
 Added a warning popup in the Chat menu explaining that chats expire
 Adjusted some text visuals for readability
 Fixed an issue where the loot pool would pull from historical best instead of your actual mission results
 Added Health readout to the inventory
 Updated the credits
 Fixed Monster Mash description
 Fixed an issue where the training grounds wouldn't fully refill your rage if you have more than 5 bars.
 Fixed display issues with telegraphs in Agnitor's fights

notes.title: Dawn of the Monsters Patch 1.0.1 Out!
notes.content:
Dawn of the Monsters
Patch notes: v1.0.1
(Steam only)

–Fixed compatibility with Steam controller settings
–Fixed an issue with various controller prompts showing incorrectly
–Cursor is now hidden in-game
–Minor localization fixes
–Fixed default keyboard bindings for second player
–Changed controller remapping behaviour for already bound inputs
